name: model-worklog-schema
description: Versioned session events for Model Logger

scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean && node -e "for (const path of ['dist', 'test-dist', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo', 'tsconfig.test.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --enable-source-maps --test "test-dist/**/*.test.js"
